randomaccess-offset-io.title: Use RandomAccess for offset-based file I/O
randomaccess-offset-io.short: Access a file position without changing shared stream position.
randomaccess-offset-io.summary: RandomAccess uses a SafeFileHandle and explicit offset to read or write a particular file region without relying on Stream.Position.
randomaccess-offset-io.why: Explicit offsets make independent file regions easier to process concurrently without competing over a shared Position.
randomaccess-offset-io.tips: Manage the file handle lifetime and remember that reads may complete with fewer bytes than requested.

conditionalweaktable-metadata.title: Attach metadata with ConditionalWeakTable without owning the key
conditionalweaktable-metadata.short: Associate extra data without keeping the key alive.
conditionalweaktable-metadata.summary: ConditionalWeakTable<TKey,TValue> associates metadata with objects while preventing the table itself from keeping its keys alive.
conditionalweaktable-metadata.why: A normal Dictionary strongly references its keys and can accidentally extend the lifetime of externally owned objects.
conditionalweaktable-metadata.tips: It is not a general Dictionary replacement; use another collection when you need key enumeration or value-type keys.

array-binarysearch-sorted.title: Search sorted arrays with Array.BinarySearch
array-binarysearch-sorted.short: Find values in sorted data with binary search.
array-binarysearch-sorted.summary: Array.BinarySearch searches a sorted array. A negative result indicates absence, and its bitwise complement gives the insertion position.
array-binarysearch-sorted.why: When the same array is searched repeatedly, binary search can avoid repeatedly scanning from the beginning.
array-binarysearch-sorted.tips: Use the same comparison rules for sorting and searching. Results are not meaningful if the array is not sorted accordingly.

file-options-sequentialscan.title: Consider FileOptions.SequentialScan for sequential reads
file-options-sequentialscan.short: Tell the OS about the expected access pattern.
file-options-sequentialscan.summary: FileOptions.SequentialScan is a hint that a file will primarily be read in order from beginning to end.
file-options-sequentialscan.why: For large sequential workloads, the OS may be able to choose caching and read-ahead behavior that better matches the access pattern.
file-options-sequentialscan.tips: Benefits depend on the OS and workload. Do not use it for primarily random access, and measure when performance matters.

task-whenall-exceptions.title: Inspect multiple failures from Task.WhenAll when required
task-whenall-exceptions.short: Account for more than one failure in concurrent work.
task-whenall-exceptions.summary: The Task returned by Task.WhenAll retains failures from multiple child tasks. The exception observed directly from await should not be mistaken for a complete failure report.
task-whenall-exceptions.why: Several concurrently running operations can fail during the same run, and diagnostics may need every failure.
task-whenall-exceptions.tips: Handling the exception from await is normally enough. Inspect the completed WhenAll task's Exception only when recording every failure is a requirement.

jsondocument-dispose.title: Dispose JsonDocument with using
jsondocument-dispose.summary: JsonDocument implements IDisposable and holds resources used while parsing. A using scope ensures those resources are released promptly.
jsondocument-dispose.why: Keeping documents undisposed in long-running code can delay reuse of internally rented memory and other parsing resources.
jsondocument-dispose.tips: JsonElement values depend on the source document lifetime. Use Clone when an element must outlive the document.

memory-owner-dispose.title: Dispose IMemoryOwner<T> after using rented memory
memory-owner-dispose.short: Return MemoryPool storage through its owner.
memory-owner-dispose.summary: MemoryPool<T>.Rent returns an IMemoryOwner<T>. Disposing the owner returns the rented storage to its pool.
memory-owner-dispose.why: Failing to dispose the owner can retain pooled storage longer than necessary and reduce reuse.
memory-owner-dispose.tips: owner.Memory can be larger than requested. Slice to the required range and never use the Memory after its owner is disposed.

stopwatch-getelapsedtime.title: Calculate elapsed duration with Stopwatch.GetElapsedTime
stopwatch-getelapsedtime.short: Convert timestamp differences to TimeSpan correctly.
stopwatch-getelapsedtime.summary: Stopwatch.GetTimestamp with Stopwatch.GetElapsedTime provides elapsed duration without manually converting the high-resolution timer frequency.
stopwatch-getelapsedtime.why: Raw Stopwatch timestamps are not TimeSpan ticks, so treating their difference directly as a duration is incorrect.
stopwatch-getelapsedtime.tips: Use Stopwatch for elapsed-time measurement; use DateTime or TimeProvider when you need a wall-clock time.

collections-marshal-setcount.title: Use CollectionsMarshal.SetCount only when every element will be filled
collections-marshal-setcount.short: Set List count directly in specialized low-level code.
collections-marshal-setcount.summary: CollectionsMarshal.SetCount changes a List<T> count directly and can support specialized code that fills preallocated storage through a Span.
collections-marshal-setcount.why: When an exact number of elements is produced in bulk, this can avoid adding each element individually.
collections-marshal-setcount.tips: The newly exposed range can contain uninitialized data. Fill every element before exposing the list, and prefer Add or AddRange in ordinary code.

cancellation-token-throwifrequested.title: Cooperate with cancellation using ThrowIfCancellationRequested
cancellation-token-throwifrequested.short: Check for cancellation at safe points in long-running work.
cancellation-token-throwifrequested.summary: CancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested throws an OperationCanceledException associated with that token when cancellation has been requested.
cancellation-token-throwifrequested.why: CPU work and custom loops do not stop merely because they received a token; the implementation must observe cancellation itself.
cancellation-token-throwifrequested.tips: Balance checking frequency in very tight loops and check at points where stopping will not leave state inconsistent.
